scope: ATR v2 knowledge-map artifacts consumed by human reading and Zotero concept navigation.
observed_failure: Six metadata-only knowledge scaffolds passed through the historical alignment and appeared as 36 concept nodes, but the v2 contract required only source_ids. It could not say which located span defined, distinguished, challenged, or merely limited a concept, so a provisional reading outline could visually resemble source-reviewed knowledge.
counterevidence: Legacy schema 1.0 maps remain useful as explicit authorial reading scaffolds when their pending status is visible.
A located span and a review-status label still do not certify field consensus or the correctness of the worker's interpretation.
proposed_mechanism: Keep schema 1.0 readable for immutable history and require new schema 1.1 maps to declare a bounded map/concept review status, source inspection state, located source inspection spans, and per-concept DEFINES/DISTINGUISHES/EXEMPLIFIES/CHALLENGES/LIMITS/CANDIDATE_ONLY evidence spans. Preserve the prior map as a historical version in Zotero.

domain_boundary.why_not_domain_specific: Any research direction can confuse a citation list with a source-reviewed definition; the six multilingual programs supplied the first full portfolio-scale replay.

evaluation.sample: All 36 concepts in the six current multilingual child authorities plus the next two independently authored knowledge maps.
route_level_metrics: number of concepts that change from apparent source grounding to explicit pending/challenged status
number of Zotero concept Notes from which a reviewer can reach the cited source and locator
number of human annotations that qualify or challenge one exact concept rather than the whole topic
reviewer disagreement about whether a definition was actually checked against full text
evaluation.rollback_rule: Relax mandatory 1.1 fields to a warning if two independent map authors cannot provide honest located spans without inventing evidence, while retaining explicit pending status and legacy compatibility.

does_not_establish: A schema-valid located map does not establish consensus, universality, causal hierarchy, novelty, human comprehension, a route decision, or a lifecycle transition.
